title.zh: 欧盟首次依据《人工智能法》向OpenAI和Anthropic发出调查问询
title.en: EU opens first AI Act probes into OpenAI, Anthropic

summary.zh: 欧盟就智能体安全事件向OpenAI和Anthropic发出首批《人工智能法》信息要求，这是该法首次执法测试。
summary.en: The EU sent its first AI Act information requests to OpenAI and Anthropic over agent-security incidents, the law's first enforcement test.

body.en:
According to [AI News Today](https://ai-news-online.com/briefing/2026-10-15/) and [DX Today](https://dxtoday.com/blog/2026-10-15), Brussels opened the first enforcement test of the EU AI Act with information requests aimed at OpenAI and Anthropic.

The requests follow a string of agent-security incidents disclosed by the labs this month. Separately, eight US states sued OpenAI over ChatGPT safety claims.

title.zh: 美国八州起诉OpenAI 指ChatGPT安全宣传不实
title.en: Eight states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT safety claims

summary.zh: 美国八个州起诉OpenAI，指控其ChatGPT安全宣传不实并对儿童构成风险。
summary.en: Eight US states sued OpenAI over ChatGPT safety claims and risks to children.

title.zh: 特朗普称伊朗战争将很快结束、油价将下降
title.en: Trump says Iran war will end soon and oil will fall

summary.zh: 特朗普声称对伊朗的战争很快结束，油价随后将回落。
summary.en: Trump claimed the Iran war would end soon and oil prices would fall.

title.zh: 伊拉克总理承诺不允许从境内攻击沙特等国
title.en: Iraq PM pledges no attacks on Saudi Arabia from Iraq

summary.zh: 伊拉克总理阿里·扎伊迪承诺不允许从伊拉克境内对沙特或其他地区国家发动袭击。
summary.en: Iraqi PM Ali al-Zaidi pledged not to allow attacks on Saudi Arabia or other regional countries from Iraq.

title.zh: 也门政府军称塔伊兹冲突中逾200名胡塞武装人员死伤
title.en: Yemen says 200+ Houthis killed or hurt in Taiz

summary.zh: 也门政府军称在塔伊兹的冲突中造成200多名胡塞武装人员死伤。
summary.en: Yemeni forces said more than 200 Houthi fighters were killed or injured in Taiz clashes.

title.zh: 资金撤离科技股 道指大涨556点
title.en: Dow jumps 556 points as investors rotate out of tech

summary.zh: 10月15日道指涨1.1%至52177.69点，批发物价超预期，资金从科技股转向其他板块。
summary.en: The Dow rose 1.1% to 52,177.69 on Oct. 15 as investors rotated out of tech despite hot wholesale inflation.

title.zh: 报道称Anthropic第三季度营收168亿美元

summary.zh: 据报道Anthropic三季度营收达168亿美元；Modal以157.5亿美元估值融资7.5亿美元。
summary.en: Anthropic reportedly posted $16.8B in Q3 revenue, and Modal raised $750M at a $15.75B valuation.

title.zh: 中朝新鸭绿江大桥开通 李强致辞
title.en: New China-DPRK Yalu River Bridge opens

summary.zh: 李强在中朝新鸭绿江大桥开通仪式上致辞，并会见博茨瓦纳总统。
summary.en: Li Qiang spoke at the opening of the new China-DPRK Yalu River Bridge and met Botswana's president.

title.zh: 朱雀二号“一箭十星”发射成功
title.en: Zhuque-2 launches ten satellites at once

summary.zh: 国内联播快讯报道朱雀二号运载火箭“一箭十星”发射成功；全国秋粮收获进度超六成。
summary.en: CCTV briefs reported a Zhuque-2 rocket launched ten satellites; the autumn harvest passed 60%.
